name: Fault Desk
office_task: Before we send a tech, check each fault call, text or alarm against our written fault list, give only our own reset steps, and book one job with what was tried.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8 or Simpro, written over its API; on Tradify a person writes the job from the triage log)
the fault list the business writes, one sheet or SharePoint list with an edition per upload, read before every triage and never written by the bot
the asset register that issues the asset_id and names each customer's model
the office's message system (Gmail or Outlook), whose drafts folder holds every written reply for a named person to send
the task list the office runs (Google Tasks, Planner or a sheet), which issues the exception_id for each parked alarm or failed job write

emits.write: one job in the job system for a fault that cannot be fixed from a written procedure, or whose procedure the customer said did not work: emergency, routine or unclassified, carrying the fault matched, the outcome, the fault list edition, the steps tried and what the customer said, so the tech knows before they leave
emits.readback: the job system returns the job_id, and reading that id back returns the job with its triage block; no id back means nothing was written, and a named person is raised (and for an emergency, handed the call at once)

emits.write: the triage added to the customer's job that is already open, marked as a duplicate of it, instead of a second job
emits.readback: reading the open job_id back returns the new triage note on it; no id back means nothing was written and a named person is raised

emits.write: a task naming the service coordinator: a monitoring alarm the fault list leaves to a person or cannot place, or a job write that returned no id
emits.readback: the task list returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the intake, the asset, the list edition and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
